description: This file defines the CustomerOptionSet entity class, which models a set of customer options with relationships to CustomerOption and CustomerOptionValue. It is used for ORM mappings with JPA annotations, including schema, primary key, and unique constraints.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSet
classes.description: Entity class representing a set of customer options linked to specific options and their values, with ordering and unique constraints.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the CustomerOptionSet.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the CustomerOptionSet.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the order index used for sorting.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the order index for sorting purposes.

methods.name: setCustomerOption
methods.description: Associates a CustomerOption with this set.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Associates a CustomerOptionValue with this set.
